Sam (People Ops): Quick note 94 payroll will be aligning the wellness stipend language in the handbook. New wording clarifies eligible expenses and tax treatment. Please ack if you manage payroll exceptions by May 20. Docs: https://confluence.company/handbook/wellness-stipend
Iris (Comp/Ben): TL;DR the stipend is still $100/mo but "eligible expenses" now list subscriptions, fitness classes, ergonomic equipment (under $400), and reimbursable mental-health services. Dependent care remains separate.
Noah (Eng Mgr): For countries where stipends are taxable, will we gross-up?
Iris (Comp/Ben): No automatic gross-up; exceptions can be requested via the payroll exception form. Add "gross-up request" in the notes field.
